Title: Home page shows the heading and the five sections in order
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The home page loads and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the page.
Step Expected: The h1 reads VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

Step Action: Read the first section heading (h2) on the page.
Step Expected: The first h2 reads Important.

Step Action: Read the second and third section headings (h2) on the page.
Step Expected: The second h2 reads Orders and the third h2 reads Schemes.

Step Action: Read the fourth and fifth section headings (h2) on the page.
Step Expected: The fourth h2 reads Results and the fifth h2 reads Accounts.

Title: Home page shows the nine action cards
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Look at the cards under the Orders section.
Step Expected: The cards Create order for current year and Create order for next year are visible.

Step Action: Look at the cards under the Schemes section.
Step Expected: The card View schemes is visible.

Step Action: Look at the cards under the Results section.
Step Expected: The cards Enter results, View results, View reports and Enter comments are visible.

Step Action: Look at the cards under the Accounts section.
Step Expected: The cards Edit customer details and Edit participant details are visible.

Step Action: Count the cards shown on the page.
Step Expected: Nine cards are shown and the h1 is still VETQAS Proficiency Testing.
